_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 5 $8042-$8154: the room shape pointer, the position mover and neighbour-pointer builder ($802D), the map seek and the record reader ($8015). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: Room shape pointer: $91EA + 18 x (A AND $1F)
regions.description: Called once, from $826B. $17:$16 := the address of room shape n, n = A AND $1F: A x 8 + A = 9 A, doubled = 18 A, plus $91EA (the 19 shapes of 18 bytes, one bit per cell, that $8278 lays into the room buffer). RUN: n = 0-31 matched $91EA + 18 n exactly (A = $23 used 3).

regions.name: Exit displacement, x: by exit code / 2
regions.description: 00 FF 00 01 00 for the exit codes N, W, none, E, S (code / 2 = 0-4): x changes by 0, -1, 0, +1, 0 ($FF added to the column byte).

regions.name: Exit displacement, y: by exit code / 2
regions.description: FF 00 00 00 01: y changes by -1, 0, 0, 0, +1. (The pair of tables is bounded by the same routine's two reads six bytes apart; the second ends on the first instruction of $8071.)

regions.name: MOVE THE POSITION (slot $802D): apply the exit to ($52, $53)
regions.description: Called by the room loaders and the game start (with $A4 = 4 for 'no move'). Y := $A4 / 2; the map column $52 += $8067,Y and the row $53 += $806C,Y; $19 := the column and $18 := the row (the targets for the seek below). RUN: all 43 (position, exit) cases tried, including every edge and corner, ended on the right cell.

regions.name: Neighbour records: start the seek at the top of the map
regions.description: The seek counters $14 (row) and $15 (column) := 0 and the walk pointer $17:$16 := $8A6E, the first world-map record.

regions.name: Neighbour pointer N ($E0/$E1)
regions.description: Unless the row is 0: seek to (row - 1, column) with $80F5 and restore the row. $E1 gets the record's high address byte and $E0 the low; for a row of 0 (no cell to the north) $E1 := 0, which marks 'none'. The five pointers are built in ONE forward walk, in raster order N, W, own, E, S, so the map is read once. The pointer table is $E0 N, $E2 W, $E4 the room itself, $E6 E, $E8 S. RUN.

regions.name: Neighbour pointer W ($E2/$E3)
regions.description: Unless the column is 0: seek on to (row, column - 1); $E3 := 0 when there is none.

regions.name: The room's own record ($E4/$E5)
regions.description: Seek on to (row, column). Every later routine reads the room through ($E4).

regions.name: Neighbour pointer E ($E6/$E7)
regions.description: Unless the column is 23 ($17): seek on to (row, column + 1); $E7 := 0 when there is none.

regions.name: Neighbour pointer S ($E8/$E9)
regions.description: Unless the row is 23: seek on to (row + 1, column); $E9 := 0 when there is none. RUN: a corner cell (0, 0) gave N = none, W = none, own = $8A6E, E = $8A71, S = $8ABC.

regions.name: SEEK: walk the world map to (row $18, column $19)
regions.description: Continues from the state in $14 (row) / $15 (column) / $17:$16 (record pointer) and stops when ($14, $15) equals ($18, $19). Each step adds the record's length, (first byte AND $0F) + 1, to the pointer; the column counter wraps at 24 and bumps the row. It only goes FORWARD, which is why the neighbours are fetched in raster order. See the world-map notes (24 x 24 records from $8A6E).

regions.name: READ THE RECORD (slot $8015): the room kind and the sub-id
regions.description: $5D := byte 0 AND $60 (the room kind: 0 plain, $20 item, $40 miniboss, $60 loop gate). Kinds $20 and $40 carry a sub-id: $5E := byte 3 and the field index $10 moves on to 4 ($10 starts at 3). Kinds 0 and $60 leave $5E UNCHANGED (stale from the last room). RUN. Sampled every kind: records [163 39 3 20] -> kind $20, sub-id 20; [67 102 25 30] -> $40, 30; kinds 0 and $60 left $5E alone.

regions.name: Read the record: the spawn-script id
regions.description: Byte 1 bit 3 = the room has enemies: then $57 := the next optional byte ($10 indexes it), with 0 read as 1; without the bit $57 := 0. RUN: [3 94 9 40] -> script 40; [2 54 9] -> 0.

regions.name: Read the record: the item type
regions.description: $55 := $A377[$5E]: the item a sub-id names (meaningful only for item rooms; for the others $5E is stale or a miniboss/other id and the value is unused). RUN: sub-id 20 -> $0E, 8 -> $0B.
